value.condition: 7a condition 3, the 75005 bar -- the firm is CARRIED THROUGH THE RELATION, DEMONSTRATED and not asserted

measurement.reading: There is NO firm/tenant/client key anywhere in the carrier's attribute vocabulary -- 20 distinct node attr keys censused across 11232 nodes, plus every edge attr key, and ZERO of them name a firm.

value.fails_earlier_than_the_bar_contemplates: The 75005 bar refuses a firm attribute PRESENT ON BOTH ENDPOINTS as 'two independent facts that happen to agree'. This carrier does not reach that bar: there is no firm attribute on EITHER endpoint, so there is nothing to travel through the relation.

only_available_firm_signal.what: a path substring, _partners/<firm>/, on the Module's attrs.path
only_available_firm_signal.why_inadmissible: L1 (7a:348-350) admits cross-plane comparison ONLY through an explicitly declared bridge, NEVER through a shared token, a shared string shape or a parse. A firm read out of a directory name is exactly the parse that clause refuses -- and it reaches only 4.8% of Modules even if it were allowed.
